mentions.name: HarToSaml
mentions.description: A web tool for analyzing SAML traffic: drop in a HAR file and get immediate insights into the SAML-related events it contains, including decoded SAML assertions, enabling SAML troubleshooting without installing the SAML Tracer browser extension.
mentions.problem: Digging through HAR files and manually decoding SAML assertions to troubleshoot SAML interactions is tedious, and SAML Tracer often can't be installed in customer environments.
mentions.audience: Developers and support engineers troubleshooting SAML authentication in customer environments where browser extensions like SAML Tracer can't be installed
mentions.source_excerpt:
I got tired of digging through HAR files and manually decoding SAML assertions and the like so I made https://hartosaml.com/.

Just drop in your HAR file and get immediate insights into the SAML related events.
